features: Directory read/close callbacks now execute through actual native request completion. Unbuffered reads expose FSREQCALLBACK execution identity/resource; close callbacks receive their native request as this and one error argument. Promise overloads use these same operation paths.

Buffered reads consume native buffered entries without scheduling another filesystem job. Callback overloads dispatch through nextTick, while synchronous work remains available when no native operation is active. Native operation queues preserve read/close ordering and concurrency errors.

Null callbacks reject synchronously; closed read(callback) and explicit read(undefined) throw synchronously while read() returns a rejection. Close marks the handle closed before dispatch and preserves asynchronous error callbacks for already-closed handles.

Ordinary unbuffered read callback exceptions are routed through the error callback. Cached-read and native-close callback exceptions reach uncaughtException once, preserving receivers, argument counts and request ownership. No public Promise monkeypatching or fabricated hook events.
limitations: These controls cover the observed Node v26.10.0 contract and unchanged pinned originals. Repeated callback throws, every queued close/read error combination, all-platform/Windows and Release/ASAN proof remain unverified under #878/#877.

Two upstream TODOs remain: direct-stream cancellation and WebSocket client context. Fifty-nine filtered cases are exclusions, not passing credit. Full Bun suite is not established by 134 passing cases and fifteen process checks.

The first custom close receiver assumption was rejected by Node and corrected; its failure remains retained. Home pre-fix null-callback failure remains retained. Source/original hashes and all positive/negative report outcomes are preserved.

General Promise/continuation hooks and other native producers remain #877; corpus #876, context #871/#856, performance #869/#873/#874/#872 and HTTPS #875/#532 remain open. Earlier excluded regressions were not rerun. Broader ABI checks were not rerun; fourteen targeted controls pass.

Pickier retains three preexisting prefer-const errors and two quote warnings; there are no additional findings in the native control file. Terminal derived-cache cleanup preserved source, installed Home, SDK and required object producers.
